main.description: Creates an invitation code for a community.

community.description: The community to create an invitation for.

maxUses.description: How many times the invitation may be redeemed, if limited.

expiresAt.description: When the invitation stops being redeemable, if ever.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The request is missing, malformed, or unverifiable service auth.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The requesting user lacks the invitation.create permission.

errors.name: CommunityNotFound
errors.description: No community exists with that DID.
